title: Skill Issue VR
description:
ABOUT

Skill Issue VR is one of the best Trickshot challenge game in the Virtual space.

In this game, it's not enough to just aim and throw - you need to think carefully about every move, as the ball's path, speed and interaction with surfaces is determined by realistic physics simulation. Your goal is simple: throw the ball so that it bounces off all objects and hits the target perfectly. But this challenge goes far beyond ordinary skill games, as each track is a unique puzzle that requires logic, strategy and precision.

The game includes:

• Unique Levels

• Creative Mode 

• Custom Maps

RULE

You are required to use all the objects on the shelves to solve each level.

BUILD THE TRACK IN ANYWAY YOU WANT! 

Each level contains optional items that you can use to make your course more exciting. The more complex your course is, the more points your solution will earn.

Are you skilled enough?

Do you have any ideas to make the game better ? 
Join our discord server!
description_short: Imagine entering a virtual world where physics and skill meet in a fun challenge! The aim of the game is simple, yet incredibly addictive: throw the ball so that it bounces over all the placed objects and finally hits the target. It's up to you to plan the route and execute the perfect throw.
